blind.description: A tall, stylized wooden shelving unit with five shelves stocked with various colorful potion bottles, alchemy reagents, and ceramic jugs. The wooden frame is dark brown with four corner posts and a panelled wooden backing. The shelves contain rows of red, green, yellow, and tan bottles and jars, with two larger storage vessels sitting on the bottom shelf. Surfaces are smooth and solid with hand-painted stylized textures, standing directly on four corner post feet without an extra base.
blind.from_above: A dark brown rectangular wooden top plank with four squared post caps protruding at the corners; one lower jar rim faintly peeks out from the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 to 5 feet tall (reaching roughly the shoulder/neck of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
